page.title: Approval Templates
page.description: Enable a platform approval template, configure form and process, then publish
page.enabled: Enabled. Click Configure Template, then publish.
page.viewMappingDescription: Read-only view of the published version; no draft is created
page.viewMappingNoPublished: No published version yet. Configure and publish first.
page.syncPreviewTip: Diff between platform latest and the current tenant draft/published fields. Confirm writes to draft; publish to take effect. Tenant-custom fields are kept.
page.syncedPlatform: Synced. Review the draft, then publish.
page.publishConfirm: Publish current template? Form fields, process deploy and approvers will be validated. Business will use this version.
page.wizardPageDescription: Steps: Form → Layout → Process design → Publish
page.wizardNeedStepByStep: Please complete the tabs in order
page.wizardLayoutHint: Bound layout: arrange existing fields from the pool only. Change field contracts in the Form step.
page.wizardLayoutValidateFail: Layout validation failed: unknown or duplicate field code
page.wizardFlowTip: Configure approval steps with the vertical designer. Condition variables come from fields marked Used in Condition. Auto-sync runs if the model is missing.
page.wizardNoConditionFields: No fields marked as Used in Condition
page.wizardNeedDeploy: Save & deploy in the process designer before continuing
page.wizardNoCategory: Missing business category; cannot sync process
page.wizardNoPlatformModel: No matching model in the platform catalog
page.wizardApproverTip: Approvers are synced from process designer nodes. This tab is read-only; go back to Process to edit.
page.wizardNeedApprover: Configure strategies for all approve nodes in Process and deploy first
page.wizardNotReady: Checklist incomplete — fix the items below and retry
page.designerKeepOne: Keep at least one approve node
page.designerDesignSotFallback: No design snapshot (design_json / process_config.design); reconstructed from approver rules. Re-save & deploy to lock Design SoT
page.designerDesignSotEmpty: No design snapshot yet; opened a default blank flow. Save & deploy after editing
page.designerNodeIncomplete: Complete strategy config for every approve node
page.designerTaskKeyPattern: Task key must start with a letter (letters, digits, _)
page.designerVariablePattern: Variable must start with a letter (letters, digits, _)
page.designerConfigInvalid: Strategy config must be valid JSON
page.designerPassModeHint: Or-sign / countersign creates multi-instance tasks for all resolvable assignees
page.designerPassSequentialAllHint: Sequential all: assignees approve one after another in order
page.designerRejectModeStarterEditHint: Suspend process; starter edits form then resubmits. Unlike re-enter first approve node.
page.designerDueDurationPh: e.g. PT24H (24 hours); empty = no timer
page.designerDueDurationHint: ISO-8601 duration; attaches a boundary timer when set
page.designerInclusiveHint: Inclusive gateway: all matching branches may run (unlike exclusive condition)
page.designerFieldPermHint: R read · W editable on approve · H hidden; unset fields default to R. Frozen with design deploy.
page.designerExprHint: Whitelist: starter / variable:name / userId:id. Validated on deploy; free EL is not supported.
page.designerKeepOneParallel: Keep at least two parallel paths
page.designerCanvasHint: Click a card to edit; use + to insert approve/CC/condition/parallel. Click Save & Deploy to persist.
page.designerNodeApplied: Updated on canvas — click Save & Deploy to persist
page.designerConditionFieldsEmpty: No condition fields available. Enable fields for conditions in the OA form; when opening the designer from workflow models alone, you can still edit EL under Advanced.
page.designerConditionExprAdvancedHint: The helper writes back here; edit EL directly for advanced rules.
page.designerConditionPriorityTip: First match from left wins. Put stricter rules left, or use Range.
page.designerConditionOverlapWarn: Possible conflict: field {field} already matches >{first} first, so >{second} may never run. Move the larger threshold left, or use Range.
page.designerConditionOverlapBlock: Invalid config blocked: field {field} priority {pri1} uses >{first}, which swallows priority {pri2} >{second}. Reorder or use Range before Save & Deploy.
page.designerConditionDupExpr: Invalid config blocked: duplicate condition expression {expr}
page.designerConditionInvalidRange: Invalid range for {field}: low must be < high (got {low}, {high})
page.designerConditionRangeHint: Builds ${leaveDays > 3 && leaveDays <= 8} to pair with neighboring branches.
page.designerKeepOneCondition: Keep at least one condition branch
page.designerConditionBranchesHint: Click each branch header to configure its condition; use Add condition beside the title for more branches. First match from left wins.
page.designerBranchDefaultEditorHint: Default branch has no expression; it runs when no other condition matches
page.designerNoNestedCondition: Nested conditions inside a branch are not supported yet
page.globalPropsPersistTip: Confirmed here is draft-only; click Save & Deploy to publish with the version.
page.globalPropsTenantScopeTip: Reserved for platform cross-tenant start ACL (startAcl.tenantIds). Not enforced in this version.
page.globalPropsAclTip: If no personnel restriction is set, anyone can start this process.
page.notifyOnUrgeHint: When enabled, starter/admin can send urge notifications on active tasks

validation.required: Please select a platform approval template

templateName.label: Template Name
templateName.placeholder: Optional override; leave blank to keep platform name
